spells.name: All-Wise's Riddles
spells.story: The dwarf who asked for Thor's daughter and was kept talking until sunrise turned him to stone.

spells.name: Pike-Dwarf's Hoard
spells.story: The dwarf who lived as a pike and held a great hoard, until Loki took it and he cursed it.

spells.name: Keening Warning
spells.source: Lady Wilde, Ancient Legends of Ireland
spells.story: The wailing woman of the Irish houses, whose cry tells a family that one of them will die.

spells.name: Annis's Cave
spells.source: Charles James Billson, County Folk-Lore: Leicestershire and Rutland
spells.story: The blue-faced hag of the Leicester hills, who lurks in her cave and snatches strays.

spells.boss_name: The Blue Men of the Minch
spells.name: Storm-Channel Rhyme
spells.source: Donald A. Mackenzie, Wonder Tales from Scottish Myth and Legend (1917)
spells.story: Blue sea-men who swim the Minch and sink any boat whose skipper cannot match their rhyme.

spells.name: Brokkr's Bellows
spells.story: The dwarf smith who forged the hammer while his brother kept the bellows steady.

spells.name: Mine-Knocker's Prank
spells.story: The knocking sprite of the German mines, who throws pebbles at the careless and hides your tools.

spells.name: Puca's Gallop
spells.source: Croker 1825; W. B. Yeats, Fairy and Folk Tales of the Irish Peasantry
spells.story: A shape-shifting spirit of the Irish roads who carries drunken riders on a wild night gallop.

spells.name: Hedge-Wanderer's Jest
spells.story: The mischievous hob of English folklore, who leads night travellers in circles for sport.

spells.name: Blood-Cap's Dye
spells.story: The border-tower goblin who dyes his cap in the blood of trespassers.

spells.name: Straw-Spinner's Price
spells.story: The little man who spun straw to gold for a price, and who stamped his name away.

spells.name: Alpine Worm's Hiss
spells.source: Johann Jakob Scheuchzer, Itinera per Helvetiae alpinas regiones
spells.story: The stub-legged worm of the Alpine passes, reported in the old travellers' accounts.

spells.name: Ring-Smith's Curse
spells.story: The Nibelung dwarf who forswore love for the gold and forged the ring that ruined heroes.

spells.name: Highland Dancer's Hunger
spells.source: John Gregorson Campbell, Superstitions of the Highlands and Islands of Scotland (1900); W. J. Watson, The Celtic Review 5 (1908-09)
spells.story: A beautiful dancer of the Highland bothies who drinks the hunters' blood by night.

spells.name: Barghest's Prowl
spells.source: William Henderson, Notes on the Folk-Lore of the Northern Counties of England and the Borders
spells.story: The black dog of the Yorkshire lanes, who walks the old road before a death.

spells.name: Green Hound's Bay
spells.source: John Gregorson Campbell, Superstitions of the Highlands and Islands
spells.story: A great green hound of the Highlands whose three bays carry across the moor.

spells.name: Headless Rider's Call
spells.source: Thomas Crofton Croker, Fairy Legends of the South of Ireland
spells.story: The headless rider of the Irish roads who halts at a door and calls a name.

spells.name: Eitri's Anvil
spells.story: The dwarf smith, brother of Brokkr, whose forge made the gold-bristled boar and Thor's hammer.

spells.name: Smith's Ale
spells.story: The smith of the Tuatha De Danann, whose spears never missed and whose ale kept the gods young.

spells.name: Kelpie's Ford
spells.source: Robert Burns, Address to the Deil
spells.story: The Scottish river horse who offers a ride to the weary and drowns the rider in the pool.

spells.boss_name: The Laidly Worm of Spindleston Heugh
spells.name: Laidly Worm's Coil
spells.source: Robert Lambe, The Laidley Worm of Spindleston-Heughs (ballad)
spells.story: The loathly worm of Spindleston Heugh, once a princess, who was cursed by her stepmother.

spells.name: Serpent-Bride's Bath
spells.story: The fairy bride of the Lusignan tales, who bathes in secret on Saturdays and is half-serpent below.

spells.name: Fox's Pardon
spells.story: The trickster fox of the medieval beast tales, who talks himself out of every trial.

spells.name: Mountain Lord's Mood
spells.source: Johann Karl August Musaeus, Volksmaerchen der Deutschen
spells.story: The temperamental mountain spirit of the Giant Mountains, kind to the kind and fierce to the scornful.

spells.name: Cart's Creak
spells.story: The Breton death-driver, whose cart creaks in the night and whose scythe is never idle.

spells.name: Lord Wolf's Return
spells.story: The lord who vanished three days a week as a wolf, until his wife stole his clothes.

spells.name: Water-Horse's Plunge
spells.source: John Gregorson Campbell, Superstitions of the Highlands and Islands
spells.story: The loch horse of the Highlands, fiercer than the kelpie, who carries riders to the bottom.

spells.name: Glamr's Stare
spells.story: The undead shepherd of Grettir's saga, whose stare once paralysed the strongest man.

spells.name: Memory Draught
spells.story: The queen who brewed a drink of forgetting and turned heroes against their oaths.

spells.name: Moon-Chaser's Leap
spells.story: The wolf who runs after the moon, and who in the end will swallow it.

spells.name: Ruthven's Charm
spells.story: The pale aristocrat of the 1819 story, who charms his way into every house and leaves it in ruin.

spells.name: Cave Prophecy
spells.story: The cave-born Yorkshire prophetess of the chapbooks, who foretold fires, wars and the fall of great men.

spells.name: Skinless Rider
spells.source: Walter Traill Dennison, in The Scottish Antiquary
spells.story: The skinless horse-and-rider of Orkney, whose breath withers crops and whose terror is the sea.

spells.name: Foster-Father's Plot
spells.story: The smith who raised Sigurd and plotted for the dragon's gold, then fell to his own plot.

spells.name: Sun-Chaser's Leap
spells.story: The wolf who runs after the sun, and who in the end will devour it.

spells.name: Smith's Lame Wings
spells.story: The lamed smith of the Germanic tales who made himself wings and flew from his captor.

spells.name: Carmilla's Embrace
spells.story: The courteous vampire of Le Fanu's tale, who befriends a girl in a lonely castle and drinks her slowly.

spells.name: Barrow-Walker's Weight
spells.story: The risen dead of the Icelandic sagas, swollen and heavy, who guard their barrow-gold.

spells.name: Erlking's Call
spells.story: The elf-king of the German ballad, who calls to a child riding in his father's arms.

spells.name: Giant's Cast
spells.story: The giant of Albion's founding tale, thrown from a cliff by Corineus the wrestler.

spells.name: Herne's Chase
spells.source: William Shakespeare, The Merry Wives of Windsor
spells.story: The spectral huntsman of Windsor forest, antlered and wreathed in chains, who walks beneath an oak.

spells.name: Cursed Blade's Oath
spells.story: The shieldmaiden who raised her father's cursed sword from a burning barrow.

spells.name: Loki's Gambit
spells.story: The shape-changing trickster of the Norse tales, who makes the gods laugh and then pays dearly.

spells.name: Wolf-Skin's Bite
spells.story: The son and nephew of Sigmund, who ran as a wolf with his father in the forest.

spells.name: Elf-Knight's Hold
spells.story: The knight held by the Fairy Queen, whom Janet won back by holding fast through every shape.

spells.name: Eagle-Giant's Raid
spells.story: The giant who took the form of an eagle to seize Idunn and her apples.

spells.name: Hammer-Thief's Ransom
spells.story: The giant who stole Thor's hammer and asked for Freyja's hand as ransom.

spells.name: Giant's Tasks
spells.story: The chief giant of Culhwch and Olwen, who set impossible tasks for his daughter's hand.

spells.name: Dolorous Stroke
spells.story: The knight of the two swords who struck the Dolorous Blow and laid a kingdom waste.

spells.name: Last Knight's Oath
spells.story: The last knight at Arthur's side, who cast the sword into the water.

spells.name: Count's Midnight Welcome
spells.story: The Transylvanian count of Stoker's novel, who greets his guest at midnight and crosses the sea to hunt London.

spells.name: Wound That Will Not Close
spells.story: The crippled lord of the Grail castle, whose land withers until the right question is asked.

spells.name: Mere-Walker's Fury
spells.story: The night-walker of the mere who stalks the hall of Heorot and tears the sleepers.

spells.name: Mere-Dam's Grief
spells.story: The monster of the mere who comes to Heorot to avenge her son, and takes the king's best friend.

spells.name: Shieldmaiden's Rally
spells.story: The shieldmaiden of Saxo who fought bare-headed at Ragnar's side.

spells.name: Lake's Enchantment
spells.story: The lady of the lake who bound the old enchanter in an everlasting sleep.

spells.name: Questing Beast's Baying
spells.story: The beast with a serpent's head and a leopard's body, with the noise of forty hounds in its belly.

spells.name: Red Knight's Sally
spells.story: The Red Knight of the Red Lands, who proves a gentle lord in Malory's tale of Gareth.

spells.name: Boar of the Combs
spells.story: The great boar-king who ranged over Wales and Cornwall with the comb and shears between his ears.

spells.name: Varney's Feast
spells.story: The tortured baronet of the penny serial, who feeds on the living and mourns it.

spells.name: Year's Cauldron
spells.story: The enchantress whose cauldron brewed a year for three drops of wisdom, then chased the thief through every shape.

spells.name: Ford's Four Days
spells.story: Cu Chulainn's foster-brother who held the ford against him for four days at Medb's command.

spells.name: Green Beheading
spells.source: Sir Gawain and the Green Knight
spells.story: The green challenger who offers a beheading game at Camelot, and keeps the bargain a year on.

spells.name: Gudrun's Vengeance
spells.story: The Volsung widow whose grief turned into a terrible vengeance on her husband's house.

spells.name: Stone-Giant's Duel
spells.story: The stone-hearted giant who challenged Thor to a duel and was crushed beneath his own whetstone.

spells.name: Wear Worm's Coil
spells.story: The worm that coiled round Penshaw Hill after a young lord fished it from the Wear and cast it into a well.

spells.name: Camlann's Betrayal
spells.story: The traitor of Camlann, who seized the crown and fell in the last battle with the king.

spells.name: Avalon's Sister
spells.story: Arthur's half-sister, a healer and an enchantress, whose schemes unsettle Camelot.

spells.name: Warrior-Teacher's Gae
spells.story: The warrior-woman of Skye, who trained Cu Chulainn in the arts of war.

spells.name: Starkad's Wager
spells.story: The Danish champion cursed with three lifetimes of crime, who struck down his own lord.

spells.name: Illusion's Trials
spells.story: The giant-king whose illusions set Thor to drain the sea, lift the cat and wrestle old age.

spells.name: Fallen Tower
spells.source: Geoffrey of Monmouth, Historia Regum Britanniae
spells.story: The high king whose tower kept falling, until the buried dragons were found.

spells.name: Barrow-Father's Warning
spells.story: The dead berserker in his burning barrow, who gave up the cursed sword only at his daughter's urging.

spells.name: Bear-Champion
spells.story: King Hrolf's champion who fought in the shape of a great bear while his body slept.

spells.name: Queen of the Iceni
spells.story: The British queen who rose against the Roman governor and burned three cities.

spells.name: Conall's Vengeance
spells.source: Tain Bo Cuailnge; Scela Mucce Meic Datho
spells.story: The Red Branch champion who kept a severed head in his belt and was famed for vengeance.

spells.name: Love-Spot's Glance
spells.story: The Fenian champion whose love-spot made women love him, and who fled with Grainne.

spells.name: Fergus's Sword
spells.story: The exiled Ulster king whose broad sword could strike off the tops of hills.

spells.name: Sun-Strong Hour
spells.story: The Orkney knight whose strength grew toward noon and ebbed as the sun went down.

spells.name: Thrice-Burned Gold
spells.story: The gold-drink of the Voluspa, burned three times and living still, who began the first war.

spells.name: Moray's Crown
spells.story: The Scottish king of the play, who murders his guest for a crown and rules in fear until Birnam Wood comes.

spells.name: Queen of Connacht
spells.story: The Connacht queen who set out on the cattle raid of Cooley to match her husband's wealth.

spells.name: Well of Mimir
spells.story: The wise being whose head Odin consulted at the well of knowledge.

spells.name: Oliphant's Blast
spells.story: The paladin of Charlemagne who blew his horn too late at Roncesvalles and died on the field.

spells.name: Lady of the Mercians
spells.story: The warrior-ruler of the Mercians in the tenth century, who built burhs against the Vikings; honourable Respectful win line.

spells.name: Annwn's Hunt
spells.story: The king of Annwn, who rode with his pale hounds and traded places with a mortal prince.

spells.name: Dunbar's Defiance
spells.story: The Countess of Dunbar, who held her castle for five months against the English siege in 1338; honourable foe with a respectful win line.

spells.name: Outlaw's Grip
spells.story: The strongest outlaw of Iceland, who wrestled the draugr Glamr and fought for nineteen years.

spells.name: Hel's Half-Face
spells.story: The half-living, half-dead daughter of Loki, who rules the realm of the dishonourable dead.

spells.name: Serpent's Revenge
spells.story: The Viking leader of the Great Heathen Army who avenged his father Ragnar upon Northumbria.

spells.name: Lake Knight's Sword
spells.story: The greatest knight of the Round Table, torn between his king and his queen.

spells.name: Washer at the Ford
spells.story: The Irish war-goddess of omens, who washes the armour of those who will die.

spells.name: Grail Fool's Question
spells.story: The innocent knight who saw the Grail procession and failed to ask the question.

spells.name: Serpent-Pit Song
spells.story: The shaggy-breeched hero of the sagas who slew a great serpent for a princess; an honourable foe with a respectful win line.

spells.name: Dragon-Blood Bath
spells.story: The dragon-slayer of the Nibelungenlied, vulnerable only where a linden leaf had fallen.

spells.name: Love-Potion's Pain
spells.story: The knight of Cornwall who drank the love-potion meant for King Mark's bride.

spells.name: Ring of Flame
spells.story: The shieldmaiden ringed by fire who awaits the hero bold enough to cross it.

spells.name: Hound of Ulster's Rage
spells.story: The Hound of Ulster, whose warp-spasm in the Tain turned him into a terror to behold.

spells.name: Salmon of Knowledge
spells.story: The leader of the Fianna, who burned his thumb on the salmon of wisdom and thereafter knew the truth.

spells.name: Hrolf's Hall
spells.story: The Danish king of Hleidr, whose hall and champions were known in every northern saga.

spells.name: Merlin's Prophecy
spells.story: The enchanter of Arthur's court, whose prophecies of Geoffrey of Monmouth shaped a kingdom.

spells.name: All-Father's Gaze
spells.story: The one-eyed wanderer who gave an eye for wisdom and hung nine nights for the runes.

spells.name: Surtr's Flame
spells.story: The fire-giant who will break the bridge and burn the world at Ragnarok.

spells.name: Hammer-Thrower
spells.story: The thunder-god of the Norse tales, who fights the giants and wades the rivers of the world.

spells.name: Dragon's Bane
spells.story: The Geatish hero who slew Grendel and his mother, and in old age gave his life against the dragon.

spells.name: Fafnir's Hoard
spells.story: The dwarf who took the shape of a dragon to guard the cursed gold, and spoke to Sigurd as he died.

spells.name: Gleipnir's Fetter
spells.story: The great wolf bound by the gods with a cord of impossible things, who will break free at the end.

spells.name: Siege Perilous
spells.source: Malory; La Queste del Saint Graal
spells.story: The pure knight who sat in the Siege Perilous and achieved the Grail.

spells.name: World-Serpent's Girth
spells.story: The great serpent that encircles the world, whose poison fells Thor at the last.

spells.name: Root-Gnawer
spells.story: The dragon that gnaws at the roots of the world-tree under the earth.

spells.name: Dragon-Star's Rule
spells.source: Geoffrey of Monmouth, Historia Regum Britanniae
spells.story: The king who saw a dragon in the sky, and begot Arthur by Merlin's art.

spells.name: First Giant's Frost
spells.story: The first giant, from whose body the gods made earth, sea and sky.
